workflow-run projects/*/*/workflows/wf_*.json

Mutable Workflow-run snapshots paired with subagents/workflows/<run>/journal.jsonl and worker transcripts. `workflowProgress` interleaves phase and worker records; worker states are `done`, `error`, `progress`, and `start`, and `cached=true` marks resume reuse. A resume can replace the current roster and task id while the journal retains older starts, so this document is not attempt history. Results are workflow-defined JSON, logs are untimestamped strings, and the full script, scriptPath, args, default model, exact status, metrics, error/result, and current progress all remain evidence. Structure-only census of a live organic dataset. Shapes sampled from the first 4096 records per type; nested facet shapes from the first 32 records per nested discriminator; observed counts cover the full tree.
